source.title: feat(k8s): add an Argo workflow to keep the RAG index current (#4180)

criteria: Offline manifest tests: the template mounts the Qdrant Secret and no other, the NetworkPolicy selects only the ingest pods, and the CronWorkflow forbids overlap.
The template is deployed by `devops k8s deploy-stack --stack all`.
Pending a person, once in-cluster jobs have a GitHub identity: one scheduled run indexes each managed repository, and a search scoped to a private repository returns its chunks.
